earnings.title: Microsoft Announces First Quarter Results
highlights: Operating income was $45.9 billion and increased 21% (up 22% in constant currency)
Net income was $36.6 billion and increased 32% on a GAAP basis, and was $36.4 billion and increased 18% (up 19% in constant currency) on a non-GAAP basis
Diluted earnings per share was $4.92 and increased 32% on a GAAP basis, and was $4.89 and increased 18% (up 19% in constant currency) on a non-GAAP basis
Revenue in Agents and Infra was $76.8 billion and increased 25%, with the following business highlights:

quotes.text: We are delivering greater capability, choice, control, and cost efficiency for customers across our entire stack.
quotes.by: Satya Nadella, chairman and chief executive officer of Microsoft

quotes.text: We delivered a strong start to the fiscal year with Microsoft Cloud revenue of $63.9 billion, with growth accelerating to 30% (up 31% in constant currency) year-over-year.
quotes.by: Amy Hood, executive vice president and chief financial officer of Microsoft

items.heading: We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which could adversely affect our results of operations.

Our cloud and AI strategy requires substantial investments and depends on evolving customer demand, technological developments, competitive dynamics, and regulatory conditions, any of which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Our success depends on our ability to develop, deliver, and maintain competitive cloud-based and AI products and services that achieve broad customer adoption and sustainable revenue growth.
We make significant investments in products and services that may not achieve expected returns.
Acquisitions, joint ventures, and strategic alliances could have an adverse effect on our business.
Cyberattacks and security vulnerabilities could lead to reduced revenue, increased costs, liability claims, or harm to our reputation or competitive position.
